title: Vulture
blurb: A vulture is a bird of prey that scavenges on carrion. There are 23 extant species of vulture.
facts: Old World vultures include 16 living species native to Europe, Africa, and Asia; New World vultures are restricted to North and South America and consist of seven species.
A particular characteristic of many vultures is a bald, unfeathered head.
This bare skin is thought to keep the head clean when feeding, and also plays an important role in thermoregulation.
